args.body: Own ALGORA-EXECUTABLE-PAID-TASK. Prefer a concrete reproducible deliverable over another general marketplace report, but establish task rules and execution fit first. A missing submission account blocks submission, not necessarily an independently useful offline fix; assess that distinction explicitly. Stop after three candidates or an inaccessible official route. Do not revisit translation listings, Shopify comparisons, CSV inventory or payment credential checks. No current demand or revenue is established by our existing artifacts.

description: Feedback remains available but has three unclassified sources and no classified commercial events; demand is unknown. The translation test rejected specific sources, including an Algora URL returning 404, which does not establish platform-wide inaccessibility. Test a different, bounded paid-work route using official evidence before producing speculative inventory. Funds and revenue remain unverified; existing observation windows stay unchanged.
